result.topic_en: Gauss chooses the phase values θ = −u, θ' = 0, θ'' = +u so that the coefficients of sin Nt and cos Nt vanish, derives the remaining condition (N+n)cos(N−n)u + (N−n)cos(N+n)u = N, and solves it numerically for u.
result.transcription:
Um die Coefficienten von $\sin Nt$ und $\cos Nt$ verschwindend
zu machen ist am einfachsten
$\theta = -u$
$\theta' = 0$
$\theta'' = +u$
zu setzen, [-wo also sein muss-] {+n+}[?] wodurch der ersten
Bedingung von selbst Genüge geschieht, und die
zweite noch erfordert:
$N(2\cos nu.\cos Nu - 1) + n(2\sin nu.\sin Nu [-...-]) = 0$
oder
$(N+n)\cos(N-n)u + (N-n)\cos(N+n)u = N$
Für unsere Zahlen ergibt sich
$(N+n)u = 0^R\,977766$ $\quad Nu = 0^R\,729095$
$(N-n)u = 0,480425$ $\quad nu = 0.248671$
$u = 7''5096$[?]

methods.what: Symmetric choice of the three phases (−u, 0, +u), which makes the coefficients of sin Nt and cos Nt vanish and satisfies the first condition automatically
The same condition rewritten with product-to-sum identities
Numerical solution of the condition for the given values of N and n (angles marked R)
